title: Sukha Singh Challenges the Pathan to Single Combat

blocks.text: Sukha Singh restrains Charat Singh and clears the field for a true single combat. Sukha Singh refuses to let the Pathan leave alive, because to spare him after such taunts would leave the slander of the Panth unanswered.

The verbal exchange becomes a formal declaration of intent. Sukha Singh openly predicts the Pathan's death, while both fighters advance with the kind of fierce composure that shows each man has accepted the duel's fatal terms.

What matters on this page is the disciplined shape of courage. The Singh does not rush as part of a mob; he insists on meeting the challenger face to face so that the Khalsa's honor is defended in the clearest possible way.
